name: Horns & Flutes of the World
subtitle: Kombu, Siwa, Ocarina & more
shortDescription: 9 horns, trumpets, whistles and flutes to play: Kombu, Lepapata, Siwa horn and Antelope-horn trumpet.
longDescription:
Horns & Flutes of the World: 9 horns, trumpets, whistles and flutes from 8 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Kombu, Lepapata, Siwa horn, Antelope-horn trumpet, Funnel trumpet, Timbalamhala, Tin whistle, Dvoyanka and Ocarina.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can blow natural horns, trumpets, whistles and flutes, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
